architectureNotes: Activity.lesson retains the complete framework/edition/control identity; no assumption that every framework has CMMC levels.

Activity payload follows LearningActivity plus coordinator-requested learningObjective, contentVersion and existing glossaryTermIds. Source-review records and task classifications remain separate from runtime question objects.
All questions use the existing accessible native single-choice interaction. Task intent varies: scenario decisions, interpretation, classification, sequence selection and misconception checks.
No diagram is required for these drafts; existing accessible diagrams/animation work can be attached later after source and text-equivalence review.
Local progress/version behavior and answer analytics are outside these content proposals; no real answer/evidence/user data collection is proposed.
